rules.when: Research that needs current external facts: breaking news, current events, today's market or product state, release versions, or up-to-date documentation.
rules.why: Requires live web search, not frontier coding: Flash medium leads on Antigravity's large Flash pool, with Sol and Grok medium as fallbacks.

rules.when: Task needs generated images or visual assets: icons, illustrations, logos, mockup art, placeholder imagery.
rules.why: Only Pi with pi-antigravity exposes generate_image; Flash medium avoids spending Argon's weekly reasoning pool on image calls.

rules.when: Review, audit, or second opinion on a diff/PR/design another crewmate produced. Not for writing the fix.
rules.why: Prefer a different model family than the author's. Fable 5.1 shares Claude's session and weekly bounds (model:fable). Argon and Antigravity Opus run at high (Antigravity's ceiling) only in low-volume tiers because their weekly pools are small. Sol runs at xhigh because Sol high scores below Sol medium.

rules.when: Recon-only, file gathering, narrow lookup, or a trivial mechanical edit (rename, format sweep, typo fix). Not for research that needs current external facts.
rules.why: Trivial effort: use the cheapest low-effort models (Luna and Flash) so workhorse Codex and frontier Claude/Argon pools are not spent here.

rules.when: Ordinary implementation, bounded bug fix, tests, everyday coding with a clear path.
rules.why: Sol medium leads high-volume coding at the lowest cost and time per task; Claude and Argon are reserved for harder, low-volume tiers, with Grok medium as fallback.

rules.when: Large/ambiguous multi-file change, risky refactor, work holding many moving parts at once.
rules.why: Sol xhigh leads on cost and speed near frontier quality, with Argon high (Antigravity's ceiling) second and Grok xhigh as fallback; Claude is reserved for second mates and the hardest tier. Sol runs at xhigh because Sol high scores below Sol medium.

rules.when: Hardest available work: root-cause investigation, architecture, ambiguous design, or already failed on the workhorse tier.
rules.why: Frontier reasoning for work that justifies maximum cost: Claude max models (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5) lead, backed by Antigravity Opus and Argon at high (Antigravity's ceiling) when the shared Claude session window is exhausted.
